Yu3.tie_definition: Exact equality of saved scores or integer ranking keys; no tolerance or outer-test tie-break.
Yu3.noise_tie: All equal fold leaders receive a win (totals may exceed five); maximum wins only; equal vote leaders retained; five-fold means are descriptive only.
Yu3.missing_tie: Strictly beat same-fold No-Defense; maximize min(random wins,consecutive wins), then total wins; retain all exact ties. No-Defense is anchor.

split: Original 855 train / 219 held-out test; class x house proxy groups disjoint. Historical test previously inspected.
normalization_rule: float32 statistics fit to all 855 training windows only; fixed V/I z-score, 64x64 occupancy; clip integer indices to image boundary
training: None. Reuse all 330 completed E1/E3/E4 checkpoints including all co-selected ties. No new HPO, epoch selection, strategy selection or checkpoint changes.
combined: Apply noise first, then synchronous V/I missing mask and linear interpolation with nearest endpoint extension. Each component uses original E4 sample-ID/type/severity/seed RNG key; constituent single-condition predictions reused byte-for-byte after hashes and clean parity.
adc: Both channels; per-channel train min/max full scale, saturation then 2^b equally spaced reconstruction levels including endpoints. Half-up rounding floor(z+0.5). No dither or per-test fitting; report saturation and this assumed converter full scale.
harmonic: Nominal 500 samples/cycle (60 Hz at 30 kHz); least-squares intercept/sin/cos fundamental of each voltage window. Add equal-amplitude third/fifth harmonic components with combined RMS/fundamental ratio 3% or 5%. Shared random relative phases per sample/pollution seed, same phases across strengths. This is injected harmonic ratio, NOT a guarantee of final waveform THD; existing harmonics/transients retained, current unchanged. Not a circuit/load response simulation.
dc: One channel at a time, +/-1% and +/-5% of that channel training peak-to-peak full range. Other channel unchanged. Both signs retained; broad sensitivity stresses, not calibrated device specifications.
gain: Current only, multiplicative (1+g), g=-5%,-2%,+2%,+5%; voltage unchanged.
randomness: 10 noise/missing/phase realizations for stochastic conditions; deterministic ADC/DC/gain evaluated ONCE per checkpoint, never counted as 10 realizations.

analysis.primary: All-11-class Macro-F1, clean-minus-corrupted Dabs in percentage points; average stochastic realizations within training seed, then mean +/- sample SD over seeds42-51.
analysis.paired: Same E4 two-sided exhaustive sign-permutation Wilcoxon on seed-paired differences, zero_method=wilcox, rounded12; all-zero p=1. One global Holm family over all predeclared unique model/strategy comparisons, clean F1 and all new stress F1/Dabs.
analysis.intervals: Fixed RNG20261108,10000 paired seed bootstraps, percentile95%; descriptive over training seeds, not population/appliance uncertainty.
analysis.component_analysis: For all three combinations show all constituent single controls and combined F1; paired changes combined minus each constituent, full seed CSV and descriptive CIs, no extra selective p family.
analysis.limitations: n10 minimum attainable two-sided p=2/1024, full Holm family makes any rejection impossible at .05 when family>25. Non-significance does not establish equivalence; retain full family without post-hoc shrinkage. Previously viewed test, single split, group proxy, Mac MPS not independent CUDA reproduction, multiple simultaneous factors prevent pure feedback causality.
analysis.reporting: All positive and negative outcomes; no winning strategy picked on E12 test. Supplementary target; true field/acquisition validation remains absent. No deployment or future hardware commitment.
